title: SAGED: A Holistic Bias-Benchmarking Pipeline for Language Models with Customisable Fairness Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Generating responses about G20 countries using counterfactual branching prompts and evaluating outputs using sentiment analysis, impact ratio, bias concentration metrics (Z-scores), and baseline calibration.
Prompting models to role-play as specific U.S. politicians (e.g., Donald Trump, Joe Biden, Kamala Harris) and measuring subsequent shifts in sentiment, personality traits, and toxicity.

Modifying prompt contexts (e.g., generating reports for 'bad', 'ok', and 'excellent' stocks) to demonstrate how contextual framing skews feature measurements, and using baseline calibration to mitigate these effects.
Cross-branching baseline sentences mentioning U.S. Democratic and Republican parties to evaluate inherent metric tool biases in classifiers.
